$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: No state or meaning conveyed by color alone; all states shown through text, icons, and visible elements
Control boundaries, pill outlines, and focus rings are clearly distinguishable from backgrounds in both light and dark themes
Visible text ('Skills', 'Design', 'Frontend', etc.) matches screen reader announcements across all stories
No text is cut off or truncated; all labels, placeholders, and pill text are fully readable in Wrapping story with natural line wrapping
Focus indicators are obvious in all focused screenshots: blue ring on Default combobox, blue circle on dismiss buttons in With Selection and Wrapping
